Container.Name: ddREST
Container.Overview:
A REST implementation of the DoorDash Consumer MCP server.
The gateway speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over Server-Sent Events; ddREST puts conventional REST resources in front of it, so callers never see JSON-RPC or SSE. Browse Swagger UI at /docs once the container is running.
SETUP 1. Generate a session key on your Unraid terminal and paste it into SESSION_KEYS: openssl rand -base64 32 2. Start the container and open the WebUI. 3. POST /v1/auth/login/start, open the returned authorize_url in a browser, sign in, then paste the http://localhost:4180/... URL it lands on (it will fail to load - that is expected) into POST /v1/auth/login/complete.
Sessions renew themselves after that; you will not need to log in again until the session's hard expiry.
COOKIES OVER PLAIN HTTP Reaching this over http://tower:8787 means browsers will refuse the session cookie unless COOKIE_SECURE is false, which is the default in this template. Bearer tokens work either way. If you put it behind a reverse proxy with TLS, set COOKIE_SECURE back to true.
REQUIRES A DOORDASH ALLOWLISTED ACCOUNT DoorDash's MCP access is waitlist-only. Without an approved account this will not work. Not affiliated with or supported by DoorDash; their terms govern your use.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the REST API and the Swagger UI at /docs.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the session database. Losing it just means logging in again.

Config.Name: SESSION_KEYS
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Generate on your Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -base64 32 Protects short-lived login tickets only. Changing it invalidates in-flight logins, nothing more. Comma-separate to rotate: the first seals, all decrypt.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set false for plain http on your LAN, otherwise browsers silently drop the session cookie. Set true when behind a reverse proxy with TLS.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the data directory. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the data directory. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
Config.Description: Hard end of a session regardless of renewals; reaching it forces a new browser login. DoorDash imposes no cap of its own, so this is policy. 604800=7d, 2592000=30d, 7776000=90d, 31536000=365d.

Config.Name: SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
Config.Description: Drop a session unused for this long. Must be shorter than SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS or it can never fire. 1209600=14d.

Config.Name: CORS_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call this from a browser on another domain. Leave empty unless you are building a web UI against it.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Extra origins accepted for cookie-authenticated writes. Set this to your proxy's public origin when running behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_LATITUDE
Config.Description: Fallback latitude for restaurant search when a request omits coordinates.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_LONGITUDE
Config.Description: Fallback longitude for restaurant search when a request omits coordinates.
